conviction_note: H1 operating profit will very likely beat the company's 3,790m plan, which is also the IFIS consensus. Q1 alone was 55.8% of the H1 plan and Q2 all-store sales ran +7.5% in the 月次. A small interim-dividend raise is likely on this company's own record. Against that, the company has not revised its full-year forecast mid-year in three years, and its last H1 and Q3 beats both fell about 4% over the window. The two cancel into p_up 52 on an abs_move of 3.0, the stock's own median window move rather than the 2.03 proxy. The findings sum is +0.4 and the scaled number +0.12. Both are small and both are positive; the gap is just the near-coin-flip p_up.
bar: H1 (Mar-Aug 2026) company plan: sales 33,300m, OP 3,790m, ordinary profit 3,800m, from the Q1 決算短信 of 2026-07-03 (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260703/140120260703587460.pdf). FY: OP 6,800m / ordinary profit 6,800m. IFIS consensus on kabuyoho equals the company plan exactly (FY ordinary profit 6,800m on 2026-10-01, 1 week and 4 weeks ago: https://kabuyoho.jp/reportAnalyst?bcode=7611). findings.finding: H1 OP will very likely beat the 3,790m plan (= IFIS consensus) by roughly 4-9%. Q1 OP was 2,114m, 55.8% of the H1 plan, against last year's Q1 share of the H1 actual of 51.1% (1,871 of 3,663). The plan implies Q2 OP of 1,676m, down 6.4% on last year's 1,792m, while the 月次 show Q2 all-store sales of +6.2/+7.9/+8.5% (Jun/Jul/Aug) and H1 +8.1% against a plan of +8.3%.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Last year's H1 (2025-10-06, 15:00) beat the 3,200m plan by 14.5%. The stock rose into the close, then fell 4.6% the next day; open to next close was -4.25%. The Q3 beat on 2026-01-06 went -4.03% (open to next close), and the Q1 beat on 2026-07-03 went +3.08% (Yahoo daily bars).
findings.why_not_priced: Largely priced. The Q1 progress and the 月次 are public, and this company routinely beats its plan (FY2026 actual OP 6,584m against a never-revised 6,000m plan). What is not visible is the Q2 margin, given rising wage and food costs. If the beat were fully priced, the stock would not have drifted down 20% from 3,665 (Oct 2025) to 2,930 while profits rose. That drift says holders doubt the margin, so a clean margin print still adds a little.
findings.independence: The August 月次 (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260903/140120260903531015.pdf) is a separate document showing H1 all-store sales +8.1%, existing-store +5.1% and 476 stores against 465. It is the same company, but it is the sales leg rather than the profit leg.

findings.finding: An interim and/or year-end dividend raise from the 26/26 yen plan is likely at this print. The company raised the dividend at each of its last three return points: interim 22→23 and year-end 22→23 at the 2025-10-06 H1 print; the FY2026 final to 29 yen (+6) on 2026-04-10; +2 yen with a buyback on 2025-01-22. It states it will 'actively raise dividends or buy back shares in line with results', at a payout of ~40% (FY2026 39.8%), against a plan EPS of 124.99 that the H1 beat will lift.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: 2025-01-22: buyback plus a 2-yen raise lifted the stock sharply the next day (kabutan: 急反発). 2025-10-06: a 1+1 yen raise lifted it into the close, then it fell the next day on the 9月 月次. 2026-04-10: the final raised +6 yen alongside a weak +3% FY guide; open to next close -0.50%.
findings.why_not_priced: The dividend plan stands at 26/26 with no revision filed (the Q1 短信 says 修正の有無：無), and the consensus page carries no dividend expectation. A raise is a same-batch announcement that retail holders read as new. If it were priced, the stock would have run up into the print; the 20-day run-up is -3.4%.
findings.independence: The FY2026 決算短信 states the policy separately: '今後も業績動向に応じて増配や自己株式取得等の株主還元策を積極的に行っていく方針' (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260410/140120260410501656.pdf). It is the same issuer but a different document.

findings.finding: The company very likely will not revise its FY forecast (OP 6,800m, +3.3%) at H1, though H1 OP near 4,000m would be about 59% of it against last year's H1/FY of 55.6%. It made no earnings-forecast revision during FY2026 despite finishing 9.7% above plan, and both of its last two in-year beats without a revision (H1 2025-10, Q3 2026-01) fell about 4% over the window.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: 2026-01-06 Q3: kabutan headline '大幅増収増益で着地も通期予想の上方修正は行われず', and the stock went -4.03% open to next close. 2025-10-06 H1: FY unchanged ('変更はございません'), -4.25% open to next close, though FISCO attributed that to the 9月 月次 slowdown.
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced. The no-revision habit is visible to anyone who reads the record, and IFIS consensus sits at the plan, so an unrevised FY does not miss the published bar. It still bites, because the realised reactions show holders selling beats that come without a raised outlook. If the market fully expected no revision, the last two such prints would not both have fallen about 4%. The upside tail, a first-ever mid-year raise, is why the range runs to +1.5.
findings.independence: Last year's H1 短信 (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20251006/140120251006568794.pdf) states the FY forecast was left unchanged at H1, and FY2026 ended at 6,584m against the 6,000m plan (kabuyoho actuals table). Both show the same habit from different documents.

findings.finding: Read-through for the September 月次, which the company releases in the same 15:00 batch as H1 (as on 2025-10-06): 王将フードサービス's September, published this morning, shows existing-store sales 99.9% (August 99.7%) and traffic hit by typhoon No.25 and heavy rain. Peer momentum is flat rather than collapsing, with a mild weather drag.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: 2025-10-07: September existing-store +6.5%, the year's slowest, was blamed for a -4.6% close-to-close drop the day after the H1 print (FISCO via kabutan, https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=7611&b=n202510070716).
findings.why_not_priced: The peer number is three hours old. Hidaka's own September is not public until 15:00 and has moved the stock before. This is a proxy: Ohsho is western-Japan-weighted and Hidaka is in the Kanto, and Ohsho's September actually improved slightly on August, so the sign is weak.

bar_hierarchy: Forecast revision: unlikely on the company's three-year record of no mid-year earnings revisions; consensus = plan, so holding the plan is neutral against IFIS but has drawn about -4% on the last two beats. Returns: a dividend raise is likely (raised at each of the last three return points; ~40% payout). New-year guide: n/a at H1. Quarter: Q1 progress against the H1 plan was 55.8%, versus a Q1 share of the H1 actual of 51.1% last year, which points to H1 OP of about 3,950-4,150m against the 3,790m plan.
baseline_tension: The positioning lean is neutral (0 short, margin 2.92, 20-day -3.4%, 5-day +2.8%). The strongest positive the release could carry is a dividend raise plus a clean H1 beat; I looked for both, and both are likely. The strongest negative is the habitual unrevised FY, which this name's holders have sold twice. My findings net slightly positive and do not cut against anything priced.
lessons_applied: Rule 1 (a negative resting on a series the market already has or on a proxy goes toward 50): the Ohsho September read-through shrank from -0.2 to -0.1, because the peer series improved slightly on August and is a western-Japan proxy.

Rule 2 (check the sign; look for the strongest positive): already done before reading. The dividend-raise and H1-beat positives were filed, and the no-revision negative rests on this name's own realised reactions rather than on visible 月次. I left it at -0.5 and p_up at 52 unchanged.
